download_wizard_model: download the wizard of wikipedia full dialogue retrieval model to a specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch wizard_package3.tgz for the wizard_of_wikipedia task
review_download_function: review the download function that configures options and calls download_models for wizard_of_wikipedia
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that sets model_type and downloads wizard_package3.tgz via download_models
test_download_function: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying wizard_package3.tgz is fetched
